name: Experimental Biology for Engineers
description: Biosafety, preparation of standard biological buffers, buffering capacity and pKa of buffers, biomolecules, whole cells and plant tissues in different buffering conditions; observing cell surface and intracellular contents using light and fluorescence microscopy, real-time video microscopy of motile cells; measuring and visualizing intracellular molecular components - proteins and genomic DNA. PCR, ELISA, antigen-antibody interaction.
